summary: One-line guard skips headers whose value is None when building the PreparedRequest's CaseInsensitiveDict, correctly preventing 'Accept-Encoding: None' from being sent while leaving all real headers intact. Minimal, targeted, matches the documented None-to-suppress convention.

issues.description: Filters None only in prepare_headers, so the request goes out without the header but session.headers still retains the None entry; acceptable since suppression is the documented intent, but per-request override semantics rather than deletion.
No inline comment explaining why None values are skipped (i.e. the 'set header to None to suppress' convention), which would aid future readers.
